claim: The IEA reports about 1.7 Wh of GPU electricity for one SD-XL 1.0-base image under controlled H100 test conditions.
comparisonContext: The controlled GPU-only benchmark is about 5.7 times the site's 0.3 Wh everyday text-prompt estimate.
scopeNote: SD-XL 1.0-base on H100 GPUs under controlled testing; GPU electricity only, not a production-serving or total-system measurement.
